title: Shortest Matching Substring
summary: Given a string s and a pattern string p with exactly two '*' characters, find the length of the shortest substring in s that matches p .
statement: Given a string s and a pattern string p with exactly two '*' characters, find the length of the shortest substring in s that matches p . If no match exists, return -1. An empty substring is considered valid.
constraints: s has up to 100,000 lowercase letters and p contains exactly two asterisks.
Each asterisk matches any sequence, including empty; the other characters are literal.
Return the shortest substring matching the entire pattern, or -1 if none exists; the empty substring is valid.
hints: Split the pattern into three literal pieces that must occur in order without overlap.
Find every piece occurrence with KMP, then link each middle occurrence to the latest valid first and each final occurrence to the best eligible pair.
Use binary search in sorted occurrence lists and prefix maxima of first starts; minimize final end minus first start.
For a fixed later endpoint, the latest compatible earlier start always gives the shortest span, including empty-piece boundary occurrences.
editorial: For a fixed later endpoint, the latest compatible earlier start always gives the shortest span, including empty-piece boundary occurrences.

tests.explanation: The shortest ordered occurrence of the three literal pieces spans eight characters.
Both stars may match empty, so the empty substring has length zero.
